args.content:
Hawaii Packing List
Emma Johnson's Vacation — Hawaii
Dates: June 10th - June 20th, 2024

Packing List (based on planned activities):

Beach & Water
  - Swimwear (multiple sets)
  - Beach towel
  - Flip-flops / sandals
  - Sunscreen (reef-safe)
  - Sunglasses and hat
  - Snorkeling gear (for Hanauma Bay)
  - Water shoes
  - Dry bag / waterproof phone pouch
  - Kayaking gear / quick-dry clothing (for Kailua Beach)

Hiking & Outdoors
  - Hiking gear (sturdy shoes, moisture-wicking clothing)
  - Daypack / small backpack
  - Reusable water bottle
  - Insect repellent

Clothing
  - Casual outfits
  - Light, breathable clothing
  - One nicer outfit (for luau / dining)
  - Light rain jacket
  - Comfortable walking shoes (for shopping and sightseeing)

Essentials
  - Camera
  - Travel documents (ID, tickets, reservations)
  - Phone charger and power bank
  - Cash and credit cards
  - Basic toiletries and medications
  - Small first-aid kit
